types_at_2.4: all sixteen sealed Model A types
seeds: none; deterministic fixtures and exhaustive declared cells
domain: The workflow domain has at most eight tasks, eight inputs, two participants, unit-duration serial scheduling and local slots 0–1,000.
request: actor, context, cue, target, owned outcome demand and at most eight accessible references; optional paid material/group references; no route, face, recipe or evaluator label
demand: workflow_need with four integer outcome priorities (personal, material, shared, system) 0..10 and boolean externalize; priorities select desired effects, not an origin or recipe
selection: Enumerate content-appropriate bundles only from the supplied references after verifying paid access. Reject missing native semantic prerequisites. Rank eligible candidates by highest destination priority, then matching externalize preference, then lowest Model A plus material effort, then canonical cell number and serialized input references. Estimate uses current participant frame and cursor. Do not infer hidden state or hypothetical physical completion.
cost: Comparison costs 1 + number of supplied references + number of candidate cells + number of examined bundles. Child effort estimate is route hop charges plus route content charges plus declared material units; excludes later recall, which is paid by native execution. No optimization or exact total-cost prediction is claimed.
budget: At most eight supplied accessible references and 64 bundles per cell. Truncation is recorded. If comparison plus estimated child work exceeds either wallet currency, candidate is ineligible; native wallet exhaustion remains authoritative.
admission: A separate admission record links paid comparison to native validation and its child or failure. Admission does not claim completion. Phase 3 adds workflow Shell application.
controls: One choice-withholding intervention per cell preserves identical paid comparison and candidates, launches no child, changes a fixed downstream availability/custody query, and is rejected by the ordinary choice auditor. Later child spending is not matched and is reported separately.
audit: Independent tools/verify_workflow_selection.py reconstructs snapshots from paid access, verifies demand ownership, candidate applicability, rank, Model A effort, comparison charges and exact native launch; calls the independent workflow auditor with an explicit new extent hook. It imports no selector or executor.
gates: 8 automatic witnesses and 8 rejected controls for 2.1; every witness feeds a later paid consumer
all 625 inherited methods and 16 Phase 1 methods unchanged
old SelectionEngine and WorkflowEngine checkpoint restoration unchanged
unpaid, foreign and forged inputs rejected
split: 2.1a freezes records and candidate policy; 2.1b adds execution, the backward-compatible audit hook and independent verifier. Neither split is credited as the complete batch until all gates pass.
failures: Preserve every attempt; stop after a gate fails twice after correction, inherited-contract/baseline change, required ruling or companion-theory contradiction.
